summary: Sow Good Inc., via subsidiary SOWG Tanzania Inc., filed an 8-K disclosing a letter extending the Sunset Date under its April 20, 2026 Share Purchase Agreement to acquire targets from Ryzon Materials Limited, Uranex Tanzania Limited, Magnis Technologies (Tanzania) Limited and Uranex ESIP Pty Limited. The deadline moves from the prior date to October 30, 2026, a fifteen-day extension. No price, stake or premium is stated. The deal appears structured as an asset/share purchase of Australian-linked entities, requiring satisfaction of closing conditions before the sunset. Watch for further extensions or termination risk if conditions remain unmet.
